label: Combinational controllability
subgoals: Assign controllability 1 to both values of every primary input
Take the cheapest input at the controlling value plus one for the controlled output
Sum the inputs at the non-controlling value plus one for the other output

label: Computing a value
subgoals: Compute each gate's two controllabilities from its inputs
Use the minimum over the two input combinations for XOR

label: What the numbers mean
subgoals: Recognize that sums double-count reconvergent inputs
Rank lines by controllability to order ATPG decisions
Flag lines with large values as random-pattern resistant
